title: HVAC Maintenance Agreements Enrollment Eligibility Table
content:
Equipment eligibility, qualifying inspection and term-length figures for HVAC Maintenance Agreements at every agreement level.

| Agreement level | Equipment types eligible | Ductless indoor heads serviced as one system | Days after enrollment to complete the qualifying inspection | All fees paid refunded when the equipment fails the qualifying inspection | Term length (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 2 | 30 | Yes | 12 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 2 | 30 | Yes | 12 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 3 | 30 | Yes | 12 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 2 | 30 | Yes | 12 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 3 | 30 | Yes | 12 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | central air conditioner, heat pump, gas furnace, ductless mini-split | 4 | 30 | Yes | 12 |

Every level's entry gate admits the same four equipment types and requires a passed qualifying inspection.

## Meaning of each column

- **Equipment types eligible**: the equipment types eligible for the agreement.
- **Ductless indoor heads serviced as one system**: the number of ductless indoor heads serviced as one system.
- **Days to complete the qualifying inspection**: the calendar days after enrollment within which the qualifying inspection must be completed.
- **All fees paid refunded on inspection failure**: whether all fees paid are refunded when the equipment fails the qualifying inspection.
- **Term length**: the length of each term, in calendar months.

## Reading across the levels

Only the ductless figure differs between levels: a ductless mini-split counts as one system for up to two indoor heads on Essential, Standard and Dual-System, up to three on Plus and Dual-System Plus, and up to four on Premier. The equipment types, the 30-day inspection window, the full refund on a failed inspection and the 12-month term are identical on all six levels.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical ductless mini-split with three indoor heads is within the one-system figure on Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus (three heads), Dual-System Plus (three heads) and Premier (four heads); on Essential, Standard and Dual-System its three heads exceed the two-head figure for one system.
